title: A tablet-based task for assessing environmental preferences in children and adults
author: Meidenbauer, Stenfors, et al.

steps.title: Provide task instructions
steps.instruction: Tell the participant: they will see sets of four pictures and must arrange them from the least liked (near the frowny face) to the most liked (near the smiley face) by dragging the images on the tablet; after ordering, press the green button to advance to the next set.

steps.title: Run practice sorting trials
steps.instruction: Carry out four practice trials using images of children’s bedrooms before the real task.

substeps.instruction: For the first trial, the experimenter moves the bedroom images on the tablet to demonstrate how to drag and order them, and reminds the child about the smiley‑face and frowny‑face anchors.
Ask the child to perform the sorting themselves after the demonstration.
Repeat the sorting task for three additional practice trials (total of four).

steps.title: Proceed to real task
steps.instruction: After the four practice trials are completed, have the child continue with the actual experimental task using the same tablet interface.
